create_InterfaceConfig: create an InterfaceConfig to generate solvent adsorbate slab and ion configurations for catalytic simulations
create_interface_on_sites: create a solvent and ion interface on top of existing adsorbate slab atoms configurations
create_packmol_atoms: create packed solvent and ion atoms in a unit cell volume using packmol
run_packmol: run packmol with an input file to pack solvent molecules in a specified geometry
randomize_coords: randomize atom coordinates within a unit cell by setting center of mass to a random position
